resources.string: Written into exported photos (EXIF and XMP) unless the export\'s metadata is set to None.
Keep your edits, versions, ratings and flags on every device, with your own Reveal sync server. Nothing goes to anyone else\'s cloud.
On the server\'s setup page, open Devices, then Pair a device, and scan the code or paste its link here.
Point the camera at the QR code on the server\'s setup page.
Reveal needs the camera only to read the pairing code. You can paste the link instead.
This is not a Reveal pairing link. Copy it again from the server\'s setup page.
The pairing code was already used or has expired (codes last 10 minutes). Show a new one on the server.
The link answers as a different server than the one in the code. Check the server address.
The server did not answer. Check that this device can reach its address.
The server could not pair this device. Try again in a moment.
The server cannot be reached. Changes wait here and go up when it can.
The server no longer knows this device (it was removed). Unpair and pair again.
The address now answers as a different server. Unpair and pair with the new one.
The server has no backup folder yet: previews and originals wait. Edits still sync.
The server reported an error. Sync tries again later.
Edits with their history, versions, ratings, flags, labels and your export author always sync.
A developable copy (about 2560 px) of photos only this device has, so your other devices can edit them.
Photos only this device has are uploaded once. Photos the server already has, such as its NAS folders, never are.
Back up originals of these folders
Reveal forgets the server on this device: its key, and the photos only the server has. Your edits stay here and on the server.
This server is reached over plain HTTP: use that address only on your home network or Tailscale, and HTTPS (a tunnel or a reverse proxy) anywhere else.
